newsitem.title: UK: Hume, 60, says will fight British election.
newsitem.headline: Hume, 60, says will fight British election.

text.p: Irish nationalist leader John Hume ended months of speculation on Saturday by announcing that he would stand for re-election at British elections due by May.
Hume, head of the Social Democratic and Labour Party (SDLP), said in a brief statement that he would contest the poll to continue the search for a lasting Northern Ireland settlement.

The Nobel peace prize nominee issued the statement on his 60th birthday. He had hitherto refused to confirm whether or not he would stand for re-election because of the pressure of work as a member of the European Parliament and poor health.
